occurrences.semantic_context: Definition of RepDist_C(p, q, w) and PresRep_D,C(x, y, w) predicates.

atomic_claims.claim_text: A distinction is representable in context C only when the projected values and their provenance carry a typed witness for the declared relation.
RepDist_C(p, q, w) iff type(p) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C and type(q) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C and TypedWitness_C(w) and Relation_C(p, q, w) and TraceCompatible_C(w).
RepDist_C is not defined by downstream outcome labels (such as reconvergence or obstruction) or residue presence.
Pi_D,C preserves a declared distinction only when a source witness has a corresponding projected witness: PresRep_D,C(x, y, w) iff RepDist_C(Pi_D,C(x), Pi_D,C(y), project_w(w)).

rejected_aliases.reason: Used in P032 for continuation selection, which belongs to the Action/Interaction domain and has different validity conditions.
